name: master-adoption
title: Adopt the React port into master (git merge with -s ours to preserve master history while taking the React tree exactly)
description: Phase 5 final step of 09-24-react-upstream-merge. User chose MERGE over reset --hard. Key insight from dry-run analysis: master is 152 commits ahead / 114 behind with 302 conflicting paths; a plain merge would resurrect 95 Angular files (src/app/) that were deliberately deleted in the React port. The safe method is 'git merge -s ours test/lcdx-react-port-audit' — takes the React working tree EXACTLY as-is while making the old master history an ancestor, so nothing is lost and the merge can never conflict. master must NOT be pushed afterwards without separate user approval (CI triggers on master push).
creator: Xavior
